title: Tuck
tagline: A bill-pay prototype that gives every bill its own pocket of money.
stateNote: A browser-only demo with play money. It is not a bank.
problem: Bills come out of one balance, so it's easy to spend money that was meant for rent or a subscription. Tuck reserves money per merchant ahead of time.
contribution: It is my project, built with plain JavaScript modules. The source is private.
worksToday: Make pockets for a merchant, amount and schedule, per the README.
Move play money in and out, and freeze demo cards.
A payment lab shows matching, declines and frozen-card behavior.
limitations: It is not a bank account or payment service; everything is simulated.
Tuck is a working name only.

media.alt: The Tuck overview: 'Big plans. Small pockets.' with demo balances split between tucked away and free to spend.

asks: Try the demo and tell me what's confusing.
